subject.title: fix(talk): preserve owner authorization in realtime consults

question: Should OpenClaw make senderId, senderIsOwner, and the capability-version constant a supported public realtime-voice plugin contract for trusted ingress plugins?
rationale: This is a permanent authorization-bearing SDK boundary, so code review cannot determine the intended plugin trust model or the compatibility commitment without maintainer direction.

options.title: Approve the narrow trusted-ingress contract
options.body: Accept the public capability as the supported way for trusted realtime voice plugins to preserve authenticated caller context, with its compatibility commitment recorded in review.

options.title: Keep sender authorization internal
options.body: Remove the public SDK export and use an owner-controlled integration seam until a broader plugin authorization contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow trusted-ingress contract
recommendation.body: Accept the public capability as the supported way for trusted realtime voice plugins to preserve authenticated caller context, with its compatibility commitment recorded in review.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied evidence shows direct ownership of the paired realtime voice integration and the proposed contract, although final API direction remains a maintainer decision.
